summary.plain: The Boson detector at ADONE: scintillators and wire chambers with magnetostrictive read-out in a compact layout covering as much solid angle as possible.
summary.technical: Boson detector: scintillators and wire magnetostrictive chambers; Frascati, Naples, Pavia and Rome. The INFN-LNF page says its place was later taken by the Naples 'proton-antiproton' experiment.

technology.quote: The "Boson" Experiment , run by physicists from Frascati, Naples, Pavia and Rome, employed a very compact setup, made of scintillators and wire magnetostrictive chambers, well suited to detect charged particle final states under the maximum solid angle.
technology.value: Very compact setup of scintillators and wire magnetostrictive chambers covering the maximum solid angle
